2609.02268.title: Retrosynthesis of Synthetic Media for Explainable AI Provenance Forensics
2609.02268.paper_summary: With the rapid proliferation of generative models on Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) platforms, reliably tracing the provenance of synthetic media without modifying generator architectures or parameters remains a major challenge. In this work, we propose a self-referential retrosynthesis framework for explainable AI provenance forensics under a fixed-generator setting. The framework leverages a jointly optimized encoder-decoder pair to implement a self-embedding mechanism that enables round-trip consistency verification. During inference, client inputs are first encoded and then processed by the generator to produce outputs with high visual fidelity. For forensic verification, the consistency between the resynthesized image and the query image is analyzed to determine whether the image originates from the target generative model. Our approach eliminates the need for watermark embedding or modifications to the generation process. Experimental results show that images generated from encoded inputs maintain visual quality comparable to original generator outputs, while decoded images reliably trace back to their corresponding source inputs. Furthermore, the framework provides interpretable evidence for generative content provenance, establishing a practical tool for explainable generative AI forensics.
2609.02268.paper_summary_zh: 隨著生成模型在機器學習即服務（MLaaS）平台上的快速擴散，可靠地追踪合成媒體的來源而不修改生成器架構或參數仍然是一個主要挑戰。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一個自參考的逆合成框架，用於固定生成器設置下的可解釋人工智慧來源取證。<lb/>該框架利用一對聯合優化的編碼器-解碼器來實現自嵌入機制，從而實現往返一致性驗證。<lb/>在推理過程中，客戶端輸入首先被編碼，然後由生成器處理以產生高視覺保真度的輸出。<lb/>對於取證驗證，分析重新合成的圖像與查詢圖像之間的一致性，以確定該圖像是否來自目標生成模型。<lb/>我們的方法消除了對水印嵌入或生成過程修改的需求。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，從編碼輸入生成的圖像在視覺質量上與原始生成器輸出相當，而解碼圖像可靠地追溯到其相應的源輸入。<lb/>此外，該框架提供了可解釋的證據，以支持生成內容的來源，為可解釋的生成人工智慧取證建立了一個實用工具。
